description: Source code for a WebM muxer implementation in the Chromium project, handling video and audio track encoding, timestamp management, and segment finalization.

classes.name: WebmMuxer::Delegate
classes.description: Handles writing data output, ensuring thread safety and sequence correctness.

classes.name: WebmMuxer
classes.description: Manages WebM segment creation, track addition, encoding, timestamp management, and finalization.

classes.name: WebmMuxer::MonotonicTimestampSequence
classes.description: Ensures monotonically increasing timestamps, adjusting for non-monotonic input.

methods.name: WriteOpusHeader
methods.description: Constructs and writes the Opus header based on audio parameters.

methods.name: GetFrameRate
methods.description: Returns a valid frame rate, defaulting to 30 if input is invalid.

methods.name: ColorFromColorSpace
methods.description: Converts gfx::ColorSpace to mkvmuxer::Colour if supported.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::OnEncodedVideo
methods.description: Handles encoded video frames, initializes tracks if needed, and manages timestamp adjustments.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::OnEncodedAudio
methods.description: Handles encoded audio frames, manages cluster timing, and track initialization.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::Flush
methods.description: Finalizes the segment and flushes queued frames.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::AddVideoTrack
methods.description: Adds a video track with specified parameters and color space info.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::AddAudioTrack
methods.description: Adds an audio track with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::FlushQueues
methods.description: Flushes queued video and audio frames to the segment.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::PartiallyFlushQueues
methods.description: Attempts to write queued frames if tracks are ready.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::FlushNextFrame
methods.description: Writes the next frame in queue, adjusting timestamps for monotonicity.

methods.name: WebmMuxer::MaybeForceNewCluster
methods.description: Forces creation of a new cluster based on timing interval.
